scope: Retrospective source-specific empirical monitor with two fixed recovery rules. Reused development outcomes were already observed in earlier experiments. No statistical independence or physical trust guarantee.
calibration: Per-source maximum absolute prediction change over EVERY same-recording fitting pair with 0<endpoint-time difference<=100ms. Includes all27178 rows/five fitting recordings using frozen OOF predictions. No truth, development or fault values used for thresholds; no margins or quantile/threshold search. Report leave-group-out exceedances without retuning.
clock_basis: Both calibration and source monitors use actual endpoint timestamps, never request-index approximations. Original request freshness/eligibility preserved; limits do not compare different source banks.
source_banks: Continuously consume each originally eligible source candidate even when not selected. Separate radar bank and five alternate fusion banks. Withholding keeps fusion only; fallback prefers permitted fusion, else independently eligible/permitted radar. Quarantine cannot revive a rejected source.
recovery: Compare latch versus return3. return3 requires three consecutively eligible distinct fresh endpoints with values within that source limit of its frozen last-accepted pre-alarm anchor; gaps>100ms or disagreement reset confirmation. No case-phase reset or truth access. This is a heuristic and can rearm poisoned content when it resembles an old anchor.
gap_and_startup: First eligible value is unverified. An unquarantined source gap>100ms reanchors; both are explicit vulnerabilities. No independent recovery witness exists.
